title: Pennsylvania School for Excellence in the Agricultural Sciences
sponsor: Penn State College of Agricultural Sciences
who_text: Pennsylvania high school juniors (public, charter, private or homeschool) whose parent or guardian lives in Pennsylvania
description: A free two-week summer program at Penn State's University Park campus for rising seniors. You live on campus, explore the agricultural sciences, and work on a service-learning project. Tuition, room, board and activities are paid for.

title: Summer College Opportunity Program in Education (S.C.O.P.E.)
who_text: 10th graders in a college-prep curriculum with at least a 3.0 GPA who are interested in education careers and are nominated by a school or organization; U.S. citizens or permanent residents
description: A four-week summer program at Penn State for students thinking about careers in teaching, counseling or other education jobs. You take college prep courses and a research and writing course that earns one college credit. The College of Education and donors cover program expenses.

title: Internships with the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania
who_text: High school and college students interested in public service
description: Pennsylvania state agencies hire high school and college students as paid interns in fields like engineering, environmental science, health care, transportation and technology. You search for openings on the state job site and apply online with a resume.
